entries.cause: W-1 slice 1 #997: the 1880 ruleset authors the tradeProtection section, so each war month adds a TradeProtectionAssessed event for the player nation, and a MerchantLossSuffered event with revenue scaling once a pool loss occurs, shifting event sequence numbers and the ledger digest from the first war month onward
entries.migrationAssessment: No save migration: tradeProtection is an optional NationState field absent from existing saves and replays are re-recorded. A save loaded without the section resolves no trade warfare and keeps its hashes. Saves already at war gain the assessment from the next resolved month
